### Hope Revived
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/today-s-insight-may-14-2013.html
Passage: Psalm 38:15
Points:
- Losing possessions or health brings difficulty, but losing hope paralyzes the soul in deep darkness.
- During prolonged suffering, people inevitably question whether their pain will ever end.
- God knows our suffering and steps in to declare an end to the trial.
- Just as spring unfailingly follows winter, hope inevitably revives and restores life to the believer.

### Wisdom from the Psalms 4/10
Author: Crosswalk.com
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/wisdom/wisdom-from-the-psalms-4-or-10-552258.html
Passage: Psalm 38:13
Points:
- Believers can resemble Peter by listening to God's truth yet failing to understand and apply it.
- In moments that call for a courageous testimony of faith, Christians often remain silent.
- God calls His followers to know Him deeply and actively proclaim their faith to others.
- Believers must break through confusion and boldly declare the Good News through words and actions.

### Devotional: Psalm 38
Author: D. A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/numbers-4-psalm-38-song-of-songs-2-hebrews-2/
Passage: Psalm 38:1-22
Points:
- David demonstrates profound candor by honestly detailing the multifaceted troubles crushing his life.
- His suffering includes physical agony, intense depression, abandonment by friends, and relentless enemy plots.
- Instead of defending his innocence against his accusers, David openly confesses his personal guilt.
- Because strict justice would condemn sinful people, David bases his plea solely on God's redeeming mercy.
